name: agent-to-program
description: Compile a recurring LLM or agent workflow into a fast, mostly deterministic program: typed decisions answered by the cheapest tier that is sure, a decision model that abstains and is calibrated against held-out groups, an independent verifier, admission tests with seeded bad inputs, shadow sampling with circuit breakers, regression-gated updates, and a wrapper harness that compiles an agent from its recorded runs.
